title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Properly Handling Relevant Trial and Enforcement Work of People's Courts in Accordance with Law during the Prevention and Control of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Properly Conducting Relevant Trial and Enforcement Work of the People's Courts in Accordance with Law During the Prevention and Control of the Infectious Atypical Pneumonia Epidemic

Fa [2003] No. 72

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Recently, certain cases related to the prevention and control of the infectious atypical pneumonia (hereinafter referred to as "SARS") epidemic have been or may be filed with the People's Courts. In order to provide strong judicial guarantees for the prevention and control of SARS in accordance with law, effectively maintain social stability, and protect the fundamental interests of the broad masses of the people, the People's Courts at all levels must, guided by the important thought of the "Three Represents", focus on the overall situation of SARS prevention and control work, give full play to their trial functions, strive to achieve an organic unity of the legal effect and social effect of judgments, and properly handle all trial and enforcement work related to SARS prevention and control in accordance with law. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. The People's Courts at all levels shall earnestly study and accurately apply the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases and other laws, administrative regulations, relevant judicial interpretations of our Court, and various national policies on SARS prevention and control, and deeply understand their essential spirit. They shall, in light of the current reality of SARS prevention and control work, provide strong judicial guarantees for SARS prevention and control work.

2. The People's Courts shall attach great importance to the trial of criminal cases related to SARS prevention and control. They shall strictly follow the Criminal Law, the Criminal Procedure Law, and the relevant provisions of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Obstructing the Prevention and Control of Sudden Outbreaks of Infectious Diseases, etc." issued by the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and shall promptly try, in accordance with law, criminal cases related to SARS prevention and control as well as other criminal cases occurring during the SARS period that affect SARS prevention and control work and social stability, and shall severely punish, in accordance with law, various criminal activities endangering SARS prevention and control.

3. Civil cases related to SARS prevention and control shall be properly handled in accordance with law.

(1) Where an employer unilaterally terminates the labor relationship with a worker on the grounds that the worker is a SARS patient, a suspected SARS patient, or a person isolated in accordance with law, or refuses to pay or delays payment of labor remuneration on the grounds that the worker, being a SARS patient, a suspected SARS patient, or a person isolated in accordance with law, affects the employer's production and business activities, and the party concerned institutes legal proceedings dissatisfied with the award of the labor dispute arbitration committee, the People's Court shall accept the case in accordance with law, and shall, based on the actual circumstances of the employer, handle the rights and obligations disputes between the parties fairly in accordance with law, protecting the lawful rights and interests of the parties.

(2) Where a party institutes a lawsuit for damages against medical and health institutions or other related lawsuits against medical and health institutions engaged in SARS prevention and control on grounds related to SARS prevention and control, the People's Court shall temporarily not accept such cases.

(3) For contract dispute cases where, due to the SARS epidemic situation, performing the contract as originally agreed has a significant impact on the rights and interests of one party, the case may be handled by applying the principle of fairness according to the specific circumstances.

Disputes arising from the inability to perform a contract directly due to administrative measures taken by the government and relevant departments for SARS prevention and control, or disputes arising from the fundamental inability of a contract party to perform due to the impact of the SARS epidemic situation, shall be properly handled in accordance with the provisions of Articles 117 and 118 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China.

4. Various types of administrative cases related to SARS prevention and control shall be properly handled in accordance with law.

(1) Where an administrative lawsuit is instituted against various specific acts taken by the government and relevant departments for SARS prevention and control, the People's Court shall inform the party in writing that it will temporarily not accept the case.

(2) Where a citizen, because he or she is a SARS patient, a suspected SARS patient, or a person isolated in accordance with law, is unable to institute an administrative lawsuit within the statutory period, the matter shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Article 40 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

(3) Administrative cases involving the investigation and punishment of illegal acts such as producing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods under the pretext of SARS prevention and control, or price gouging, which disrupt and undermine market order, shall be accepted and tried in accordance with law.

(4) To ensure the implementation of administrative measures for preventing and controlling the SARS epidemic and maintaining social order and economic order, for relevant cases where an administrative organ applies for compulsory enforcement, the People's Court shall review and handle them in accordance with law. Where enforcement conditions are met, enforcement measures shall be taken promptly in accordance with law.

5. Enforcement work related to SARS prevention and control shall be carried out earnestly, and various problems that may arise during enforcement work shall be properly handled in light of the actual circumstances.

(1) Where a party is delayed in applying for the enforcement period due to SARS prevention and control, the People's Court shall handle the matter in accordance with the provisions of Article 76 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

(2) During enforcement work, the People's Court shall not adopt property preservation measures or compulsory enforcement measures such as sealing up, freezing, detaining, or appropriating funds and materials explicitly designated for SARS prevention and control.

(3) For enforcement matters that need to be handled urgently but cannot be handled by traveling to another location due to the SARS epidemic, the local People's Court may be entrusted to handle them on its behalf. The relevant People's Court shall conscientiously and actively handle enforcement matters entrusted by other People's Courts and shall not shirk or refuse.

6. Where a party, due to being a SARS patient, a suspected SARS patient, or a person isolated in accordance with law, is unable to exercise civil claims in a timely manner, the provisions of Article 139 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China concerning the suspension of the statute of limitations shall apply.

7. After a People's Court accepts a case or renders a judgment during the SARS prevention and control period, if any of the following circumstances exist, the court shall, upon examination and confirmation, rule to suspend the trial or suspend the enforcement in accordance with the provisions of Articles 78 and 80 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, Articles 99 and 181 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 136(4) and Article 234(5) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 51(4) and (7) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China:

(1) A party or other litigation participant or litigation participant who must appear in court is a SARS patient, a suspected SARS patient, or a person isolated in accordance with law;

(2) A party or other litigation participant or litigation participant who must appear in court is unable to participate in the litigation activities because he or she has been subject to isolation measures;

(3) A party applies for suspension of trial or suspension of enforcement because there is a SARS epidemic situation at the location of the accepting court or at the location of the property to be enforced;

(4) Other circumstances where the People's Court deems that the trial or enforcement of the case should be suspended in order to facilitate the prevention and control of SARS.

In areas where the SARS epidemic is relatively serious or the types of cases are relatively special, when implementing the scope of cases temporarily not accepted as determined in this Notice, the High People's Court may, in light of local actual circumstances and in accordance with the spirit of the provisions of this Notice, make appropriate adjustments and report them to the Supreme People's Court for recordation.

8. During the SARS prevention and control period, the People's Courts at all levels shall, in conjunction with the trial work of relevant cases, strengthen legal publicity, expand the social effect of trials, and create a good legal atmosphere for SARS prevention and control work.

Each High People's Court, especially those in areas where the epidemic has already occurred, shall strengthen research and investigation into trial work related to SARS prevention and control. Important or sensitive cases accepted or tried, as well as related circumstances and issues, shall be reported promptly to the Supreme People's Court.

Each High People's Court may send this Notice to the Party Committee, the People's Congress, and the government at the corresponding level.

June 11, 2003
